title: Forward catalog clearing configuration
statement: Let $i$ be one of the $k$ work tapes, let $d$ be a configuration with a phase in the three-phase sweep system, and let $r$ be a natural number. Define a new configuration by setting its phase to the forward sweep and moving the head on tape $i$ right by $r$ positions; all other fields, including all tape contents and other head positions, are retained.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is an index among the $k$ work tapes
$d$ is a configuration with a sweep phase
